experience.trigger: Understand how Landometer turns city data into decisions across Land, Location and Living.
experience.oneJob: Inspire a public visitor, show relevant product proof, and offer a direct next action.
experience.firstAha: The dated proof band opens 38 CityMETER views, 45 CityWiki area guides, 51 Landom people and 120 works without presenting null system figures.
experience.cleanCompletion: Explore a product, share an exact example, send the team a message, or leave without a synthetic retention loop.

capabilities.sweepingNavigationCta: finite once; no ambient loop; hidden while page motion is paused or reduced
capabilities.heroOrientationMotif: Landometer 1.2.1 landometer.logo.full is the prominent animated brand opening over the hero photograph; decorative, transparent carrier, exact fail-open still, 2.87 s finite once, and no replay, loop or parallax
capabilities.landometerSectionMotifs: 11 decorative placements per locale use six unique verified full-colour Landometer 1.2.1 SVG fallbacks across logo, layers, rings, dial, cultivate and slice families; every instance uses blue ink and a transparent carrier by owner instruction; each animation is finite once after at least 14% visibility with no replay, loop or parallax
capabilities.cityChatProductMotif: owner-approved CityChat animated light logo composite in the product brand row: exact base PNG plus observed bubbles SVG from both supplied archives; transparent carrier; finite once after at least 14% visibility; no replay, loop or parallax; the observed overlay bytes are governed by an artifact-scoped owner exception because their SHA-256 differs from the package register
capabilities.ijjiProductLogoSting: verified ijji r3 mark-only logo sting at 64 × 64 px in this product brand row; the explicit owner request to balance it with peer marks is an artifact-local exception and does not amend the package's 160 px minimum guidance; transparent carrier remains an artifact-local owner override; nine layers load and decode after intersection while the exact still remains until readiness or on failure; finite once with no replay, loop or parallax
capabilities.staticContentParallax: bounded scroll-linked translation on substantial static content imagery; reduced-motion and the visible page control freeze every layer; hero media, brand marks, motif stages, provider surfaces, video and testimonial identity assets are excluded
capabilities.locationQuestionCarousel: six semantic source cards plus sanitized aria-hidden inert six-card head and tail clone cycles; matching logical source/clone cards reveal together, the rail auto-advances, pauses for visitor interaction or global/reduced motion, loops manually in both directions for pointer, touch and arrow keys, and preserves the logical card after resize
capabilities.testimonialCarousel: six semantic source cards plus sanitized aria-hidden inert six-card head and tail clone cycles with the same reveal parity, considerate auto-advance, interaction pause, bidirectional manual loop and resize-stable behavior
capabilities.locationCtaSingleLine: local TH/EN verification at 320, 360, 390, 600, 601, 630, 640, 700, 768, 900, 1080, 1081, 1280 and 1440 px: all computed nowrap, zero .btn overflow, no Location CTA above 48 px and no page overflow
capabilities.primaryCtaTreatment: primary conversation and submit actions use governed outline geometry, a contextual high-contrast surface and a finite solid-yellow underline sweep; reduced or user-paused motion removes the decorative sweep while keeping the real control visibly actionable
capabilities.captionFlow: all twelve visible media captions remain opaque, hit-testable flow siblings below their images, outside transformed image layers, at every tested viewport
capabilities.thaiNameWrapping: each Thai testimonial name is tokenized so wrapping can occur between name components but never inside a given name or surname
capabilities.mobileCitymeterShowcase: at 700 px and below a three-example CityMETER preview rail follows the CityMETER product card immediately; the full desktop showcase remains unchanged
capabilities.thailandMapCentering: both Business Dynamics Thailand-map snapshots use the same centered presentation in JavaScript, reduced-motion and no-JavaScript states

network.loadTimeSubresources: Primary page rendering remains same-origin. In both themes, official provider surfaces begin only when their cards approach the viewport.

socialEmbeds.activation: In both light and dark themes, IntersectionObserver uses a 480 px root margin and no social iframe src or TikTok script exists before near-viewport activation; Facebook receives its measured width clamped to 180–500 px and Instagram height follows its measured card width
socialEmbeds.freshness: TikTok creator, Facebook timeline and Instagram profile content are rendered from provider-owned endpoints on each activated page load subject to provider caching; LinkedIn is one explicitly featured post, not a claimed latest feed; the non-rendering X timeline is omitted while its outbound profile link remains in the footer
socialEmbeds.themeBoundary: Landometer-owned card shells, headers and surrounding surfaces follow the selected DS theme. Cross-origin provider internals retain provider styling and are not recoloured, inverted or represented as DS-themed content.
socialEmbeds.localObserved: Real TikTok, Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn provider content loaded in dark. A dark-light-dark switch preserved every iframe src and TikTok loaded state; the DS shell changed from rgb(252, 252, 250) to rgb(32, 41, 45), the dark embed surround was rgb(43, 53, 52), and no substitute cards appeared. At 390 px the Instagram iframe/card measured 436/499 px with 57 px before the next card and no fake blank tail.
